features.name: Receipt capture and recognition
features.description: Capture a receipt with the rear camera or choose an image, optimize it, send it to the Supabase OCR function, and parse the result.
features.user_value: Reduces repetitive typing while preserving a review step.
features.caveat: Network-dependent and non-deterministic unless the sample receipt is preflighted. Screenshots are intentionally rejected.

features.name: Manual expense entry
features.description: Create a categorized expense with amount, merchant, wallet, date/time, optional photo, and notes.
features.user_value: Provides a reliable fallback when no receipt is available.

features.name: Adaptive spending dashboard
features.description: Shows greeting, mascot insight, selected period spending, budget progress, income, remaining budget, expense count, and customizable category tiles.
features.user_value: Gives a fast, friendly overview of current finances.
interaction_sequence: optionally tap mascot for another insight

features.name: Transaction ledger
features.description: Unified expense, income, cash-in, and transfer history with search, filters, calendar view, details, edit, and delete/revert actions.
features.user_value: Keeps money movement searchable and auditable.

features.name: Wallets, category budgets, and savings goals
features.description: Tracks wallet balances, income, transfers, category limits, and goal progress.
features.user_value: Connects each expense to available money and monthly limits.
interaction_sequence: show updated balance and budget progress

features.name: Analytics and actionable insights
features.description: Computes income-versus-expense overview, category structure, trends, recurring merchants, unusual spending, and budget recommendations from real records.
features.user_value: Turns transaction history into understandable spending patterns.
required_state: at least three prior-month expenses for unusual-spending insight

features.name: Offline budget assistant
features.description: Answers a fixed class of budget and spending questions locally from selected-month data.
features.user_value: Provides private, instant explanations without a network request.

features.name: Onboarding and account access
features.description: Three-page onboarding plus sign-up, sign-in, verification, password reset, and password recovery.
features.user_value: Introduces the product and protects personal financial records.
